summary.text: John Pfeiffer, a Republican from Orlando, was first elected to the Oklahoma House of Representatives in 2014 and represents House District 38. His page says he serves as Deputy Majority Floor Leader.

paragraphs.text: District 38 includes all of Grant County and parts of Garfield, Kay, Logan and Noble counties.
Pfeiffer is a lifelong Logan County resident and a rancher raising Angus cattle.
He served in the Marines from 2009 to 2014, including a deployment to Afghanistan in 2011, and graduated from Mulhall-Orlando High School.
He lives on his farm in Orlando with his wife, Sierra, and their son.

sources.title: Representative John Pfeiffer (Oklahoma House of Representatives)
